name: Endpoint Detection & Response Evaluation
description: Evaluation and assessment of endpoint detection and response solutions. Covers EDR detection coverage mapping against MITRE ATT&CK, telemetry completeness and fidelity assessment, bypass resilience testing, alert quality and false positive analysis, sensor deployment and configuration review, response capability validation, and comparative product evaluation for security product selection.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands EDR architecture, detection mechanisms, and evaluation concepts
evidence: Can explain EDR agent architecture, telemetry sources, and detection pipeline
Understands the difference between signature, heuristic, and behavioral detection
Familiar with MITRE ATT&CK Evaluations methodology and results interpretation
Completed introductory training on endpoint security products

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Tests EDR detection capabilities and reviews configurations under supervision
evidence: Executed standardized test cases (Atomic Red Team, MITRE ATT&CK tests) against EDR under guidance
Reviewed EDR agent deployment, exclusion policies, and configuration settings
Assessed basic telemetry completeness for common attack techniques
Documents detection gaps and alert quality with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently evaluates EDR detection coverage and bypass resilience
evidence: Independently evaluated EDR products against ATT&CK technique matrix
Assesses detection fidelity, alert quality, and false positive rates
Tests bypass resilience using varied payload delivery and execution methods
Produces structured EDR evaluation reports with coverage gap analysis

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Conducts comprehensive EDR evaluations; develops testing frameworks
evidence: Develops comprehensive EDR evaluation frameworks covering detection, prevention, and response
Evaluates EDR kernel-mode components and telemetry collection mechanisms
Performs comparative evaluations of multiple EDR products with standardized methodology
Mentors team on EDR evaluation methodology and detection engineering

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on EDR evaluation; shapes product selection and detection strategy
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's EDR evaluation methodology
Published research on EDR detection capabilities or bypass techniques
Advises organizations on EDR product selection and deployment architecture
Trains teams and presents at conferences on endpoint security evaluation

assessment_methods.description: Evaluate an EDR product's detection coverage against a defined set of ATT&CK techniques, documenting detection, prevention, and telemetry gaps
Review EDR evaluation reports including detection coverage matrix and bypass resilience findings
